description: Read-only compact comparison of 2 to 6 products. Returns `compared` (count), `missing` (ids not found, never an error), `note` and `tools`, one compact record each: id, name, dataset, `checked` date, every plan with price and its headline limits or rates, `free` tier and `overage` policy. Products may come from different datasets. Platform fees and pass-through costs (LLM tokens, speech, telephony) stay separate rows; sum them yourself when the user wants an all-in figure. Ids as returned by list_tools or search_limits; a product name also works. Prices USD.

tool_ids.description: Two to six product ids or names, e.g. ["vapi", "retell", "elevenlabs-agents"].

name: compare_tools
title: Compare products side by side
